restoration_note: This kephalaion describes the Lord's operative power (Living Spirit) and the Mother of Life ordering the rational into a fitted dwelling, articulated through the architect parable: stones polished, wood worked from rawness through crucible into vessels of every form, that when the King (= the Third Ambassador, the Lord's call to the rational) comes, he may find a house prepared for his glory. The end opposes the wise (taken up to the region of light) and Error with Darkness (gathered and cast into the abyss) — the lexicon's structural separation of the two essences. Editor's restorations cluster densely around chapter formulas, the cosmogonic dyads (First Man + Five Sons; Living Spirit + Mother of Life), and the architect-image (ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲧⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ ⲉϩⲁⲕⲱⲧ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲟⲓⲕⲟⲥ) and have been confirmed. The middle sections (3238–3256) are catastrophically damaged with multi-gap clusters and no apparatus traces; these are honestly marked unrestorable. The closing arc (Third Ambassador + raising the wise + casting Error/Darkness to the Deep) is well constrained by the lexicon and has been restored at high confidence.
